name: maintenance_io_concurrency
description: Controls the number of concurrent I/O operations allowed during maintenance tasks (e.g., VACUUM, CREATE INDEX) per backend.
symptoms: High I/O latency spikes during bulk maintenance
tuning_tips: Set to the number of physically independent storage devices (e.g., SSDs or RAID groups) available for parallel maintenance I/O; avoid exceeding hardware concurrency limits to prevent I/O saturation.
